The named-hash scope resolver's cases (hashscope.go): which declaration a
`%h` use sees, and whether the state feature is on there. A `my` or a
`state` with its feature on is padhv, no rv2hv; `our`, `local` and a hash
no declaration reaches are rv2hv. Each snippet is a fixture of
hashscope_test.go, with perl 5.44.0's rv2hv count.

=== innermost my shadows our
our %h; { my %h; keys %h; } keys %h;
--- facts
rv2hv 2 wider
faithful

=== closed block's my does not leak
{ my %h; } keys %h;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 wider
faithful

=== use before my is the package hash
keys %h; my %h; keys %h;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 wider
faithful

=== use before my in the same statement
my $n = (keys %h, my %h); keys %h;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 wider
faithful

=== local of an our hash
our %h; local %h; keys %h;
--- facts
rv2hv 3 wider
faithful

=== initialiser sees the outer hash
my %h = keys %h;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 wider
faithful

=== condition's my reaches its block, not past it
while (my %g = ()) { keys %g; } keys %g;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 wider
faithful

=== state with the feature on
use feature "state"; state %h; keys %h;
--- facts
faithful

=== state with the feature off
no feature "state"; state %h; keys %h;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 wider
faithful

=== state with no feature at all
state %h; keys %h;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 wider
faithful

=== use v5.10 enables state
use v5.10; state %h; keys %h;
--- facts
faithful

=== use v5.36 enables state
use v5.36; state %h; keys %h;
--- facts
faithful

=== feature on inside a block
{ use feature "state"; state %h; keys %h; }
--- facts
faithful

=== feature on inside a block ends with it
{ use feature "state"; } state %h; keys %h;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 wider
faithful

=== signature hash parameter is a my of the body
use feature "signatures"; sub f ($x, %o) { keys %o; } keys %o;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 wider
faithful

=== C-style for init reaches its condition
for (my %h = (); keys %h; ) { keys %h; } keys %h;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 wider
faithful

=== class field seen by a method
use v5.40; use feature "class"; no warnings; class C { field %h; method m { keys %h; } }
--- facts
faithful

=== declared_refs declares the hash
use feature "declared_refs", "refaliasing"; no warnings; my \%h = {}; keys %h;
--- facts
anonhash 1 exact
faithful

=== development bundle 5.9.5 enables state
use 5.009005; state %h; keys %h;
--- facts
faithful

=== development bundle 5.9.4 does not
use 5.009004; state %h; keys %h;
--- facts
rv2hv 1 wider
faithful

=== state turned on through a module
use if 1, feature => "state"; state %h; keys %h;
--- facts
faithful

=== use experimental signatures
use experimental "signatures"; sub f (%o) { keys %o; }
--- facts
faithful

=== use experimental class, method signature
use experimental "class"; class C { method m (%o) { keys %o; } }
--- facts
faithful

=== class feature method head is a signature
use feature "class"; no warnings; class C { method m (%o) { keys %o; } }
--- facts
faithful
